# SO-101 camera neck model: provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 , `Simulation/SO101/so101_new_calib_camera.xml` and `Simulation/SO101/assets/` |
| Commit | `a758567c3978dfeefe282ede0500085a48fe8f78` (repository HEAD when fetched; the SO101 folder last changed in `5f6d2b876a53`, 2026-09-23) |
| Retrieved | 2026-10-08 |
| License | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE` in this folder is the repository's license file, unchanged). The repository's README states no separate terms for the simulation files. |
| Model | SO-101 "new calibration" (each joint's zero is the middle of its range) with the official wrist camera mount and camera bodies (the "camera" variant), generated by onshape-to-robot from the authors' CAD |
| Used as | the camera neck, attached to the OpenArm torso at load time by `src/neck.py` |

## Files and modifications

The files here are **byte-for-byte the upstream files** (SHA-256 below). Nothing in them was edited. Every change to the
model is made in memory at load time by `src/neck.py` from `robot_specs.NECK_SPECS`: the moving jaw, the gripper
joint and actuator and the wrist-roll joint and actuator are removed (the wrist-roll link stays as a rigid part, locked at
its zero), mesh paths are made absolute, and the model is attached to the torso with a name prefix. Only the meshes used by
the XML were copied (the leader-arm and old-calibration files were not).
